allowed.BSD-3-Clause: Permissive, with the no-endorsement clause; GPL compatible.
allowed.Apache-2.0: GPL-3.0 compatible (its patent terms are why it is not GPL-2.0 compatible; the app is GPL-3.0-or-later).
allowed.MPL-2.0: Weak copyleft; section 3.3 allows combining with GPL code, the MPL files stay MPL.
allowed.LGPL-2.1-only: Section 3 lets a recipient convert it to GPL-2.0-or-later, so it combines with GPL-3.0-or-later.
allowed.LGPL-3.0-only: Combines with GPL-3.0 (LGPL-3.0 is GPL-3.0 plus extra permissions).
allowed.LGPL-3.0-or-later: Combines with GPL-3.0 (LGPL-3.0 is GPL-3.0 plus extra permissions).
allowed.GPL-2.0-or-later: The 'or later' option lets the combined work be GPL-3.0.
allowed.BlueOak-1.0.0: Permissive (MIT-like) with a patent grant; GPL-3.0 compatible.
allowed.CC-BY-4.0: Attribution license for data and content only (for example caniuse-lite), not for code; keep the attribution in NOTICE.md / the build when such data ships.
allowed.MIT-0: MIT without the attribution requirement; GPL compatible.
allowed.BSL-1.0: Boost license, permissive; FSF-listed as GPL compatible.

notAllowedNotes.GPL-2.0-only: Not compatible with GPL-3.0-or-later (no 'or later' option).
notAllowedNotes.AGPL-3.0: Adds a network-use clause to the whole combined work; needs a deliberate exception.
